name: Loom
tagline: Async screen recording with instant hosting, transcripts, and team sharing

pricing.notes: Official/Atlassian pricing checked 2026-07-30; Business listed around $18/user/month.

verdictSummary: Local screen recording is easy, but instant hosting, permissions, viewer analytics, comments, trimming, and team libraries push it beyond one sitting.
coreLoopDIY: Record screen and camera, encode video, upload to storage, generate transcript/summary, and serve a share page.
whyPeopleStillPay: They pay because a Loom link works everywhere and preserves context for the team.

priorArt.name: OBS Studio

notes: Classic paid-for-polish case: the local primitive is free, the workflow is subscription.
prompt:
Build me a personal replacement for Loom (Async screen recording with instant hosting, transcripts, and team sharing). Requirements:

- Core loop: Record screen and camera, encode video, upload to storage, generate transcript/summary, and serve a share page.
- Needs: screen capture API.
- Needs: ffmpeg.
- Needs: object storage.
- Needs: hosted app.
- Needs: auth.
- Needs: optional transcription API.
- Keep it personal-scale: no accounts, no telemetry, secrets in .env, SQLite or
  flat files for storage. Local-first wherever possible.
- Clean minimal UI where one is needed; CLI is fine where one is not.
- Include a README with setup steps, required keys, and any OS permissions.

Honest scope: this covers the core loop only. You will not get: instant reliable hosting; permissions; comments.
